brief.headline: Push PIK PLASTICS down ₹8.48 L/yr to match the lowest prices we already pay to other suppliers for the same packaging

priceAsk.summary: Drop their prices to match our best suppliers on each item — starting with the big bottle where they charge 11.5% more
priceAsk.target: ₹8.48 L annual saving by matching best prices we pay; on the PET BOT AMBER 250ML bring ₹8.49/NOS down to ₹7.62/NOS (the TPAC price)
priceAsk.basis: We already buy identical rigid plastic packaging from TPAC Packaging India and Suraj Blow Plast at these lower prices — PIK PLASTICS should match them or explain why they can't

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 Days After Receipt — no extension

brief.financialLeverage: PIK PLASTICS publishes no financials, so we don't know their size, profit or how tight their cash is. Our ₹1.92 Cr annual spend with them is meaningful but we have no view on what share of their business that is. Without their numbers we lean harder on the fact that we have five credible second sources already lined up and a clear price gap to close. Because their finances are dark, the plan is to be firm on price — match our best or risk losing volume — and to move faster on qualifying a backup.

evidence.point: We overpay them ₹8.48 L every year versus the cheapest suppliers we use for the same items
On the biggest SKU — PET BOT AMBER 250ML/28MM — PIK charges us ₹8.49/NOS while TPAC delivers it at ₹7.62/NOS, an 11.5% gap costing us ₹7.19 L/yr
Market research shows a typical 28 mm PP cap runs ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with room to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume — so their pricing has headroom
Our annual spend with PIK PLASTICS is ₹1.92 Cr — a sizeable account they should want to keep

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (private, ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score 65/100)
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter, specialises in pharma bottles, caps and preforms — the top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd (listed)
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader making pails, containers and pharma packaging — strong and profitable, a robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Pearl Polymers Ltd (listed, PET bottle/jar specialist)
alternates.why: Listed PET bottle and jar maker under the Pearlpet brand — direct fit for our PET bottle needs

risks: PIK PLASTICS shares no financial information, so we can't see early warning signs of trouble or judge how hard to push — watch for any supply hiccups and accelerate backup qualification
If they refuse to match TPAC's ₹7.62/NOS on the big bottle, be ready to shift that ₹7.19 L/yr line to TPAC or one of the three listed alternates

The market research shows typical caps at ₹0.85–0.95/pc with volume discounts possible down to ₹0.65–0.80 — if PIK resists the price cut, check whether we're ordering in small batches that keep unit costs high
The marketBackups list includes Reliance, IVL Dhunseri and others — these are leads to qualify (verify capability and get quotes before treating them as real options), not approved sources yet
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're paying you ₹8.48 lakh more each year than our other suppliers charge for the same bottles and caps — let's close that gap today, starting with the 250 ml amber bottle where TPAC is 11.5% cheaper.
